newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada names new junior ag/fish minister.
newsitem.headline: Canada names new junior ag/fish minister.

text.p: Prime Minister Jean Chretien on Tuesday named a junior minister to cover agriculture and fisheries and oceans.
Chretien had held off naming Gilbert Normand, a Quebec physician, as a secretary of state until a recount of the tightly contested result in his electoral district.
David Anderson is fisheries minister and Lyle Vanclief is agriculture minister.
A statement by Chretien's office did not mention any experience for Normand in agriculture or fisheries but said Normand had extensive community involvement in tourism and economic development.
The cabinet now includes 28 full ministers and nine secretaries of state -- a total that was three more than in Chretien's first term.
